text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...A blunder on my part.

Duramente suffered an injury.
It seems her condition is worse than expected.
choice_data_list: Looks like some bed rest is needed for a while.
Looks like you'll need to rest quietly for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot agree to that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Missing even a single day of training
severely dulls your instincts.
Taking back those instincts takes more than just one day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If the rest period drags on...
how far will she fall behind? It cannot be ignored.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself will only drag this out longer. Let's rest for now.
...All right. I'll put together a different regimen.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

I told her that if her injury worsened and required
months of rest, she wouldn't even be able to run in the race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Withdrawing from the race... I'd like to avoid that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Forgive me, but—I will focus on resting for a while.
Duramente accepted the decision and took some time to rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
choice_data_list: ...Let's stop here. I can't let you push yourself any further.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I was getting impatient.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for being so unreasonable.
I will rest until I've fully recovered.

By overexerting herself,
Duramente's injury worsened...

After finishing about half of the alternative routine
I devised, Duramente returned.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. No problem.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "It's thanks to you building my regimen around underwater exercises, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: With this, there's no need to halt our progress.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off to finish the rest.
I won't push myself too hard, so don't worry.
While following an alternate training menu, Duramente soon made her return.
